purpose: Procure a governed auto-approval gate layer for the AIGC pipeline that can auto-pass low-risk internal artifact stages, require human review for elevated-risk actions, and auto-deny forbidden actions.

stage_requests.description: Generate visibility ledger for phases 2 through 24.
Generate repeated phase occurrence schedule showing guard loops between phases.
Generate Google Workspace and Secret Manager reference-only procurement plan without mutating Google Cloud or exposing secrets.
Generate controlled Save Credential Broker flow that records approved vault targets and audit metadata only.
Record requested capability flags as procurement intent while keeping effective authority blocked.
Record human-in-loop automation access request flags as true and map hiring/work source domains to safety parameters without live connector activation.
Generate per-source gate records for every listed hiring/work platform.
Classify repository files without moving them.
Plan possible future file moves without performing them.
Generate reviewable employer-facing deliverable packet without submitting externally.
Generate audit-view cockpit with proceed or deny decision controls.
Proceed decision requires exact phrase and human review, and still records handoff only unless future approved connector exists.
Future live connector automation requires separate reviewed activation, connector allowlist, secret broker, redaction, rate limits, idempotency, and audit receipt.

gate_invariants: Auto-approval can only approve internal artifact generation and metadata classification.
Auto-approval cannot approve external action, credential use, raw secret logging, physical file movement, source rewrite, or workflow rewrite.
Google Secret Manager procurement can generate a command plan and references only; it cannot mutate Google Cloud from this stage.
Save Credential Broker procurement can define vault targets and flow only; actual credential saving requires operator action inside an approved vault surface.
Credential payload display is denied in ordinary UI, advanced UI, logs, reports, artifacts, and workflow output.
Work source gate procurement can classify sources only; it cannot activate live connectors.
Medium-risk internal stages can auto-pass only when effective runtime authority remains false for dangerous capabilities.
Access automation procurement can record requested human-in-loop capabilities as true, but live connector activation requires separate review.
Employer deliverable packets can be auto-generated, but employer submission handoff requires human review.
Every gate decision must be written to packet, report, and audit ledger.
